europe_now.title: Spain imposes border checks on Italian travellers amid migrant dispute
europe_now.summary: Spain has implemented border checks on Italian travelers following escalating tensions over migration management between the two EU countries. The measures aim to control migrant flows but have intensified disputes at the Ceuta border.

sources.headline: Spain starts border checks on Italy over Ceuta dispute

europe_now.title: Russian strikes kill four as Kyiv hits oil refinery
europe_now.summary: Russian military attacks in Ukraine have caused significant casualties, including four deaths near Kyiv's oil refinery. The strikes underscore the persistent security threats amid ongoing diplomatic and military developments.
